items.title: Can MSFT Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: Beyond the headlines, Microsoft has quietly signed up over 30 million paid seats for its Microsoft 365 Copilot. This rapid adoption is not just an extension of its existing software business. It marks a fundamental pivot in how the company monetizes its core enterprise relationships, moving toward a consumption-based model.
